options.content: The twin is an offline estimate, not a sensor or safety control. No model output is currently ingested. See the digital-twin documentation before interpreting estimates.

targets.query: from(bucket: "hvac") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hvac" and r._field == "core") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
